name: ii Clock
author: tslove923
description: Time · date · ISO week label styled after the illogical-impulse Quickshell bar's ClockWidget.

schema.label: Time format
schema.description: Qt date/time format string for the clock, e.g. 'h:mm ap' or 'HH:mm'.

schema.label: Date format
schema.description: Qt date/time format string for the date, e.g. 'ddd, MM/dd'.

schema.label: Show date and week
schema.description: Show the date and ISO work-week alongside the time.
